title: Carousel Video Ads for Product Stories | AIVideosUGC
description: Turn one product photo into a sequenced carousel video ad, then add your headline and price after download. Choose a format for feeds and product pages.
h1: Carousel Video Ad That Walks Through One Product
lead: Place one product photo in a scene and add the headline or price after download. Keep the whole clip on that one product.
steps_h2: How to Make a Carousel Video Ad in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: The shots stay in the order you describe. The headline and price stay in your editor until you confirm them.

steps.d: Upload one photo of the product shoppers will see on the product page. Keep the full item visible.
Describe the shots in order, then pick a size and a length from 6 to 30 seconds. Keep every shot on the same item.
Download the file and add the headline or price in your editor. Post it where shoppers already browse.

faq.q: What is a carousel video ad?
faq.a: One ordered clip about a single product, from an opening look to an in-use shot and a clear finish. It is a video, not a stack of still cards.

faq.q: How do I make a carousel video ad?
faq.a: Upload one product photo, describe the shots in the order shoppers should see them, pick a size and length, then download.

faq.q: Should one carousel video ad show two products?
faq.a: No. Keep every shot on the same item so the sequence is easy to follow. Put a second product in another file.

faq.q: Who is a carousel video ad for?
faq.a: Fashion and electronics shops that want an Instagram, Facebook or product-page clip to walk through one item.
One sharp photo of the item that appears on the page you will link to, with the full shape visible.

faq.q: Which size and length fit a feed sequence?
faq.a: 1:1 for a square feed, 9:16 for Reels, plus 16:9, 4:3 or 3:4. Use 6 seconds for a short reveal, 10 or 15 for a few shots, or 30 when the story needs more.

faq.q: Can I place a headline and price on the video?
faq.a: Add the headline, price and call to action in your editor after download. The file does not include a headline or price.

faq.q: Do I need a multi-camera shoot?
faq.a: No. The shots come from one photo. You do not book a location or a creator to get the sequence.
24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15 and 120 for 30. You see the cost first. A failed job returns its credits. Plans start at $24.50 a month.

faq.q: Where can I post the file?
faq.a: In your own paid ads, feed posts and product pages. The download has no watermark. Captions are added after download, and any person on screen is an AI performer, not a customer.
